title: December 2024 Round-up
summary: Explore User and Group Graphs, Fact Ratings, and SOC 2 Type 2 Certification!
body_markdown:
To close out the year, we have several new and updated features to announce, and details of Zep's recent SOC 2 Type 2 compliance certification.


## Navigate User Graphs with Zep's New Graph Explorer


User Graph Explorer


From a user's profile page, click the " *View Graph* " button to open up a visualization of the user's knowledge graph. Zoom in and click on a node or edge for details. This is a great tool for both exploring how Zep works and investigating how user memory.


Zep v4 adds graph navigation through the API, so an agent can[navigate the graph by connection](https://www.getzep.com/blog/zep-api-for-agents/) .


### View Group Graphs


[Group Graphs](https://help.getzep.com/concepts#user-vs-group-graphs) are Zep knowledge graphs that may be used by a group of Users. They're not tied to a specific user and so we have a new " *Groups* " section of the Zep web app. View your project's list of Group Graphs, facts stored in the graph, and click the " *View Graph* " button to explore a visualization of the graph.


Group Graph List and Graph Explorer


### Rating Graph Facts for Relevance


Not all Facts are relevant to your application and users. For example, a mental health assistant may need to recall important facts about a user’s family, but what the user ate for breakfast Friday last week is unimportant.


[Fact Ratings](https://help.getzep.com/chat-history-memory/facts#rating-facts-for-relevancy) are a way to help Zep understand the relevance of a Fact to your particular use case. After implementing Fact Ratings, you can specify a minimum rating when retrieving Facts from Zep, ensuring that prompt only contains high-signal context.


Fact Ratings may now be applied to both[User](https://help.getzep.com/api-reference/user/add) and[Group Graphs](https://help.getzep.com/api-reference/group/add) .


### Be Assured with SOC 2 Type 2 Certification


Zep's infrastructure and internal processes are now SOC 2 Type 2 certified. This validates our enterprise-grade security controls through independent audits, giving you and your customers verifiable confidence in our data protection standards while streamlining your own compliance reviews.


You may view our realtime compliance status on[Zep's Trust Website](https://trust.getzep.com/) .


SOC 2 Type II Compliant


Wishing you and your families a Happy Holidays!


-The Zep Team
